correctness.rationale: Stratifying the split-product curve estimate by u=r/gcd(r,s) isolates u=2 as the only X^{1/2} case; coprimality forces (r,s)=(2h,h), reducing the pair sum by one power of the length cutoff and giving raw exponent 3/4 at theta=1/20. Substitution into the independently published length-sensitive forest summation gives 13/16, while all competing branch exponents are strictly smaller. Exact rational exponent checks are included.

originality.rationale: Chojecki's inspected current preprint states raw exponent 4/5 and short-gap mass 9/10. Sneiderman's pinned public reconstruction improves the latter to 43/50 but explicitly retains raw exponent 4/5. Searches of SCOPE, the relevant public audit source, and external literature found no matching 3/4, 13/16, or 2927/3698 refinement. Ryan Kielhorn's closely related September 2026 Zenodo preprint was not inspected in full and remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result sharpens a recent quantitative boundary for the same canonical construction, identifies the structural one-parameter worst case in the curve count, combines it with a prior length-sensitive forest improvement, and yields the stronger all-fixed-log-powers density convergence statement.
